101	async fn update_shell_channel(
102	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
103	    receipt: &deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt,
104	    force: bool,
105	    allow_prerelease: bool,
106	    yes: bool,
107	    quiet: bool,
108	) -> Result<()> {
109	    if receipt.channel != Channel::Shell {
110	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
111	            "update: shell updater requires shell receipt, got {}",
112	            receipt.channel.as_str()
113	        ))));
114	    }
115	    let current = update_current_version(receipt);
116	    let latest = resolve_latest_update(paths, &current, allow_prerelease).await?;
117	    // When the newest release is itself a prerelease (the RC era has no
118	    // stable), the updater must be allowed to install it without requiring
119	    // --pre — otherwise update reports nothing to do while the check above
120	    // names a newer version.
121	    let effective_prerelease = allow_prerelease || latest.version.contains('-');
122	    let backup_dir = unique_shell_backup_dir(&shell_backup_root(paths));
123	    confirm_shell_update(yes, &current, &latest, receipt)?;
124	    let backup_dir = create_shell_update_backup(paths, receipt, backup_dir)?;
125	    match run_shell_swap(receipt, force, effective_prerelease, quiet).await {
126	        Ok(()) => {
127	            prune_shell_backups(paths)?;
128	            if !quiet {
129	                println!(
130	                    "{}",
131	                    update_shell_completed_surface(&current, &latest, &backup_dir, receipt)
132	                        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
133	                );
134	            }
135	            Ok(())
136	        }
137	        Err(source) => Err(shell_update_failure(receipt, &backup_dir, &source)),
138	    }
139	}

141	fn create_shell_update_backup(
142	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
143	    receipt: &deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt,
144	    backup_dir: PathBuf,
145	) -> Result<PathBuf> {
146	    let root = shell_backup_root(paths);
147	    fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;
148	    fs::create_dir_all(&backup_dir)?;
149	    fs::copy(&receipt.binary_path, backup_dir.join("deadreckon"))?;
150	    fs::write(
151	        backup_dir.join("receipt.json"),
152	        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(receipt)?,
153	    )?;
154	    Ok(backup_dir)
155	}

246	            "This shell update can mutate the active binary, so non-interactive execution must pass --yes after reviewing the target release.",
247	            vec![
248	                ("channel".to_string(), "shell".to_string()),
249	                ("current".to_string(), current.to_string()),
250	                ("target".to_string(), latest.version.clone()),
251	                ("archive".to_string(), latest.archive_url()),
252	                ("updated".to_string(), receipt.binary_path.display().to_string()),
253	            ],
254	        ),
255	        vec![("Recommended", "deadreckon update --yes")],
256	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon update --check")],
257	    )
258	    .expect("shell update --yes refusal verdict surface must be valid")
259	}

264	
265	fn unique_shell_backup_dir(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
266	    let stamp = Utc::now().format("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%3f").to_string();
267	    let mut candidate = root.join(&stamp);
268	    let mut suffix = 1_u32;
269	    while candidate.exists() {
270	        candidate = root.join(format!("{stamp}-{suffix}"));
271	        suffix += 1;
272	    }
273	    candidate
274	}

276	async fn run_shell_swap(
277	    receipt: &deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt,
278	    force: bool,
279	    allow_prerelease: bool,
280	    quiet: bool,
281	) -> std::result::Result<(), String> {
282	    if std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_SHELL_FAIL").is_some() {
283	        return Err("test requested swap failure".to_string());
284	    }
285	    if let Ok(replacement) = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_SHELL_REPLACEMENT") {
286	        fs::copy(replacement, &receipt.binary_path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;

292	#[cfg(feature = "selfupdate")]
293	async fn run_axoupdater_shell_update(
294	    receipt: &deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt,
295	    force: bool,
296	    allow_prerelease: bool,
297	    quiet: bool,
298	) -> std::result::Result<(), String> {
299	    let mut updater = axoupdater::AxoUpdater::new_for("deadreckon");
300	    updater.set_release_source(axoupdater::ReleaseSource {
301	        release_type: axoupdater::ReleaseSourceType::GitHub,
302	        owner: "gregce".to_string(),
303	        name: "deadreckon".to_string(),
304	        app_name: "deadreckon".to_string(),
305	    });
306	    let version = update_current_version(receipt)
307	        .parse::<axoupdater::Version>()
308	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
309	    updater
310	        .set_current_version(version)
311	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
312	    if let Some(parent) = receipt.binary_path.parent() {
313	        updater.set_install_dir(parent.to_string_lossy().to_string());
314	    }
315	    if allow_prerelease {
316	        updater.configure_version_specifier(axoupdater::UpdateRequest::LatestMaybePrerelease);
317	    }
318	    if force {
319	        updater.always_update(true);
320	    }
321	    if quiet {
322	        updater.disable_installer_output();
323	    }
324	    updater.run().await.map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
325	    Ok(())
326	}

338	fn prune_shell_backups(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Result<()> {
339	    let root = shell_backup_root(paths);
340	    let mut backups = fs::read_dir(&root)?
341	        .filter_map(|entry| {
342	            let entry = entry.ok()?;
343	            entry.path().is_dir().then_some(entry.path())
344	        })
345	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
346	    backups.sort();
347	    let remove_count = backups.len().saturating_sub(3);
348	    for backup in backups.into_iter().take(remove_count) {
349	        fs::remove_dir_all(backup)?;
350	    }
351	    Ok(())
352	}

389	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
390	    persist_detected: bool,
391	) -> Result<deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt> {
392	    if let Some(receipt) = read_receipt(paths)? {

421	fn update_check_surface(channel: Channel, current: &str, latest: &LatestUpdate) -> VerdictSurface {
422	    let evidence = vec![
423	        ("channel", channel.as_str().to_string()),
424	        ("current", current.to_string()),
425	        ("latest", latest.version.clone()),
426	        ("release", latest.release_url.clone()),
427	    ];
428	    if latest.update_available {
429	        return VerdictSurface::try_new(
430	            VerdictKind::Preview,
431	            "update",
432	            Some(channel.as_str()),
433	            ExplanationPanel::new(
434	                "DeadReckon found a newer release for this install channel.",
435	                "The check is read-only; run the channel update command to apply the available release.",
436	                evidence,
437	            ),
438	            vec![("Recommended", channel_native_update_command(channel))],
439	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon doctor")],
440	        )
441	        .expect("update-check preview verdict surface must be valid");
442	    }
443	
444	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
445	        VerdictKind::Noop,
446	        "update",
447	        Some(channel.as_str()),
448	        ExplanationPanel::new(
449	            "DeadReckon did not find a newer release for this install channel.",
450	            "The installed version is already current, or the check fell back to cached/current release metadata.",
451	            evidence,
452	        ),
453	        vec![("Recommended", "deadreckon doctor")],
454	        Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
455	    )
456	    .expect("update-check no-op verdict surface must be valid")
457	}

465	            "DeadReckon cannot replace a source-built binary in place.",
466	            "Source installs do not have a managed package channel for self-update; reinstall from the checkout so Cargo rebuilds the binary.",
467	            vec![
468	                ("channel".to_string(), "source".to_string()),
469	                ("current".to_string(), current.to_string()),
470	                ("managed swap".to_string(), "unsupported".to_string()),
471	            ],
472	        ),
473	        vec![("Recommended", "cargo install --path crates/deadreckon")],
474	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon update --check")],

489	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
490	pub(crate) struct LatestUpdate {
491	    version: String,
492	    release_url: String,
493	    archive_url: Option<String>,
494	    sha256: Option<String>,
495	    update_available: bool,
496	}
497	
498	impl LatestUpdate {
499	    fn archive_url(&self) -> String {
500	        self.archive_url.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
501	            // release_url is the human tag page
502	            // (…/releases/tag/vX); assets live under
503	            // …/releases/download/vX/<asset>.
504	            let download_base = self
505	                .release_url
506	                .trim_end_matches('/')
507	                .replace("/releases/tag/", "/releases/download/");
508	            format!("{download_base}/deadreckon-installer.sh")
509	        })
510	    }
511	
512	    fn sha256(&self) -> &str {
513	        self.sha256.as_deref().unwrap_or("see release checksums")
514	    }
515	}
516	
517	pub(crate) async fn resolve_latest_update(
518	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
519	    current: &str,
520	    allow_prerelease: bool,
521	) -> Result<LatestUpdate> {
522	    let now = Utc::now();
523	    let cache = read_cache(paths)?;
524	    if let Some(cache) = cache.as_ref()
525	        && !cache.is_stale(now)
526	    {
527	        return Ok(LatestUpdate {
528	            version: cache.latest_version.clone(),
529	            release_url: cache.release_url.clone(),
530	            archive_url: None,
531	            sha256: None,
532	            update_available: cache.update_available,
533	        });
534	    }
535	
536	    match fetch_latest_update(allow_prerelease).await {
537	        Ok(mut latest) => {
538	            latest.update_available = version_is_newer(current, &latest.version);
539	            write_cache(
540	                paths,
541	                &deadreckon_core::update_cache::Cache {
542	                    checked_at: now,
543	                    latest_version: latest.version.clone(),
544	                    current_version: current.to_string(),
545	                    release_url: latest.release_url.clone(),
546	                    update_available: latest.update_available,
547	                },
548	            )?;
549	            Ok(latest)
550	        }
551	        Err(_) => Ok(cache.map_or_else(
552	            || LatestUpdate {
553	                version: current.to_string(),
554	                release_url: "https://github.com/gregce/deadreckon/releases".to_string(),
555	                archive_url: None,
556	                sha256: None,
557	                update_available: false,
558	            },
559	            |cache| LatestUpdate {
560	                version: cache.latest_version,
561	                release_url: cache.release_url,
562	                archive_url: None,
563	                sha256: None,
564	                update_available: cache.update_available,
565	            },
566	        )),
567	    }
568	}
569	
570	async fn fetch_latest_update(allow_prerelease: bool) -> std::result::Result<LatestUpdate, String> {
571	    if let Ok(delay_ms) = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_FETCH_DELAY_MS")
572	        && let Ok(delay_ms) = delay_ms.parse::<u64>()
573	    {
574	        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay_ms)).await;
575	    }
576	    if std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_OFFLINE").is_some() {
577	        return Err("offline test mode".to_string());
578	    }
579	    if let Ok(version) = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_LATEST_VERSION") {
580	        let release_url =
581	            std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_RELEASE_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
582	                format!("https://github.com/gregce/deadreckon/releases/tag/v{version}")
583	            });
584	        return Ok(LatestUpdate {
585	            version,
586	            release_url,
587	            archive_url: std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_ARCHIVE_URL").ok(),
588	            sha256: std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_SHA256").ok(),
589	            update_available: false,
590	        });
591	    }
592	
593	    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
594	        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3))
595	        .build()
596	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
597	    if allow_prerelease {
598	        return fetch_newest_any_release(&client).await;
599	    }
600	
601	    let url = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_RELEASES_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
602	        "https://api.github.com/repos/gregce/deadreckon/releases/latest".to_string()
603	    });
604	    let stable = client
605	        .get(url)
606	        .header(reqwest::header::USER_AGENT, "deadreckon-update")
607	        .send()
608	        .await
609	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())
610	        .and_then(|response| response.error_for_status().map_err(|err| err.to_string()));
611	    match stable {
612	        Ok(response) => response
613	            .json::<GithubRelease>()
614	            .await
615	            .map(GithubRelease::into_latest_update)
616	            .map_err(|err| err.to_string()),
617	        // The release-candidate era has no stable release, so releases/latest
618	        // 404s. Mirror the installer: fall back to the newest release of any
619	        // kind instead of silently reporting "up to date".
620	        Err(_) => fetch_newest_any_release(&client).await,
621	    }
622	}
623	
624	async fn fetch_newest_any_release(
625	    client: &reqwest::Client,
626	) -> std::result::Result<LatestUpdate, String> {
627	    let url = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_RELEASES_URL")
628	        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://api.github.com/repos/gregce/deadreckon/releases".to_string());
629	    let releases = client
630	        .get(url)
631	        .header(reqwest::header::USER_AGENT, "deadreckon-update")
632	        .send()
633	        .await
634	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
635	        .error_for_status()
636	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
637	        .json::<Vec<GithubRelease>>()
638	        .await
639	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
640	    let Some(release) = releases.into_iter().next() else {
641	        return Err("no releases found".to_string());
642	    };
643	    Ok(release.into_latest_update())
644	}

646	#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
647	struct GithubRelease {
648	    tag_name: String,
649	    html_url: String,
650	}
651	
652	impl GithubRelease {
653	    fn into_latest_update(self) -> LatestUpdate {
654	        LatestUpdate {
655	            version: self.tag_name.trim_start_matches('v').to_string(),
656	            release_url: self.html_url,
657	            archive_url: None,
658	            sha256: None,
659	            update_available: false,
660	        }
661	    }
662	}
663	
664	fn version_is_newer(current: &str, latest: &str) -> bool {
665	    let current = current.trim_start_matches('v');
666	    let latest = latest.trim_start_matches('v');
667	    match (
668	        semver::Version::parse(current),
669	        semver::Version::parse(latest),
670	    ) {
671	        (Ok(current), Ok(latest)) => latest > current,
672	        _ => latest != current,
673	    }
674	}

676	async fn providers_list_command(
677	    models: bool,
678	    all: bool,
679	    full: bool,
680	    json_output: bool,
681	) -> Result<()> {
682	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
683	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
684	    let active = read_config(&paths.config_path())?.default_provider;
685	    let ids = if all {
686	        registry.ids()
687	    } else {
688	        configured_provider_ids(&paths)?
689	    };
690	    let mut results = Vec::new();
691	    let mut missing = Vec::new();
692	    for id in ids {
693	        if let Some(descriptor) = registry.get(&id) {
694	            results.push(descriptor.probe(ProviderProbeOptions { ping: false }).await);
695	        } else {
696	            missing.push(id);
697	        }
698	    }
699	    let surface = providers_list_verdict_surface(&results, &missing, all);
700	    if json_output {
701	        let primary_action = surface.primary_action.command.clone();
702	        println!(
703	            "{}",
704	            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(json!({
705	                "kind": "providers",
706	                "id": if all { "all" } else { "configured" },
707	                "status": "ok",
708	                "next_actions": [primary_action],
709	                "try_lines": Vec::<String>::new(),
710	                "paths": {
711	                    "home": paths.home(),
712	                    "config": paths.config_path(),
713	                },
714	                "providers": results,
715	                "missing_providers": missing,
716	                "active": active,
717	            })))?
718	        );
719	        return Ok(());
720	    }
721	    println!("{}", ui_heading("provider registry"));
722	    if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
723	        println!("{} no configured providers", ui_muted("-"));
724	        println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
725	        return Ok(());
726	    }
727	    for id in &missing {
728	        let marker = if active.as_deref() == Some(id.as_str()) {
729	            "*"
730	        } else {
731	            " "
732	        };
733	        println!(
734	            "{marker} {} {} {} | {}",
735	            ui_warn("✗"),
736	            ui_id(id),
737	            ui_warn("not registered"),
738	            ui_command("deadreckon providers list --all")
739	        );
740	    }
741	    for result in &results {
742	        let Some(descriptor) = registry.get(&result.id) else {
743	            continue;
744	        };
745	        print_provider_list_row(&result, descriptor, active.as_deref(), full);
746	        if models {
747	            print_provider_models(descriptor);
748	        }
749	    }
750	    println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
751	    Ok(())
752	}
753	
754	fn providers_list_verdict_surface(
755	    results: &[ProviderProbeResult],
756	    missing: &[String],
757	    all: bool,
758	) -> VerdictSurface {
759	    let failed = results
760	        .iter()
761	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Failed)
762	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
763	    let ok = results
764	        .iter()
765	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Ok)
766	        .count();
767	    let skipped = results
768	        .iter()
769	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Skipped)
770	        .count();
771	    let subject = if all { "all" } else { "configured" };
772	    let kind = if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
773	        VerdictKind::Noop
774	    } else if missing.is_empty() && failed.is_empty() {
775	        VerdictKind::Verified
776	    } else {
777	        VerdictKind::Blocked
778	    };
779	    let primary = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
780	        format!("deadreckon detect {}", first.id)
781	    } else if !missing.is_empty() || results.is_empty() {
782	        "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()
783	    } else {
784	        "deadreckon detect".to_string()
785	    };
786	    let what = if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
787	        "DeadReckon found no configured provider routes.".to_string()
788	    } else if missing.is_empty() && failed.is_empty() {
789	        format!("DeadReckon listed {ok} usable provider route(s).")
790	    } else {
791	        format!(
792	            "DeadReckon listed provider routes and found {} issue(s).",
793	            failed.len() + missing.len()
794	        )
795	    };
796	    let why = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
797	        format!(
798	            "{} is not ready; inspect that provider before using it for a run.",
799	            first.id
800	        )
801	    } else if !missing.is_empty() {
802	        "At least one configured provider is not registered; list all routes or change the configured provider."
803	            .to_string()
804	    } else if results.is_empty() {
805	        "There is no configured provider inventory yet; listing all routes is the safest discovery step."
806	            .to_string()
807	    } else {
808	        "The configured provider inventory is readable; a detect pass can refresh setup diagnostics."
809	            .to_string()
810	    };
811	    let mut evidence = vec![
812	        ("scope".to_string(), subject.to_string()),
813	        ("providers".to_string(), results.len().to_string()),
814	        ("ok".to_string(), ok.to_string()),
815	        ("failed".to_string(), failed.len().to_string()),
816	        ("skipped".to_string(), skipped.to_string()),
817	        ("missing".to_string(), missing.len().to_string()),
818	    ];
819	    if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
820	        evidence.push(("first failed".to_string(), first.id.clone()));
821	        if let Some(message) = &first.message {
822	            evidence.push(("reason".to_string(), message.clone()));
823	        }
824	    }
825	    if let Some(first) = missing.first() {
826	        evidence.push(("first missing".to_string(), first.clone()));
827	    }
828	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
829	        kind,
830	        "providers",
831	        Some(subject),
832	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
833	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
834	        vec![
835	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon detect"),
836	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon providers list --all"),
837	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon config provider cli:codex"),
838	        ],
839	    )
840	    .expect("providers list verdict surface must be valid")
841	}

843	fn print_provider_list_row(
844	    result: &ProviderProbeResult,
845	    descriptor: &deadreckon_providers::registry::ProviderDescriptor,

967	    };

976	                } else {

978	                }
979	            })
980	        })
981	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
982	            if failed.is_empty() {
983	                "deadreckon providers list".to_string()
984	            } else {
985	                "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()
986	            }
987	        });
988	    let what = if failed.is_empty() {
989	        match requested_id {
990	            Some(id) => format!("DeadReckon verified provider probe {id}."),
991	            None => "DeadReckon completed provider detection without failed probes.".to_string(),
992	        }
993	    } else if failed.len() == 1 {
994	        format!("DeadReckon found provider {} is not ready.", failed[0].id)
995	    } else {
996	        format!(
997	            "DeadReckon found {} provider probes are not ready.",
998	            failed.len()
999	        )
1000	    };
1001	    let why = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
1002	        first.message.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
1003	            "A provider probe failed, so setup must be repaired before it can run work.".to_string()
1004	        })
1005	    } else {
1006	        "All failed-provider checks passed; the selected provider catalog is ready for the next setup or run command.".to_string()
1007	    };
1008	    let mut evidence = vec![

1016	        evidence.push(("credential".to_string(), first.credential.clone()));

Based on my analysis, I traced every changed file and the new sinks introduced in the diff:

**Files analyzed:**
- `providers.rs` — the only substantive code change. New `effective_prerelease` derivation, new `fetch_newest_any_release` fallback, new `archive_url` URL transformation, and a rename of `gdc` → `gregce` org. All other source-text changes in the diff are organization renames in identifiers/URLs/tap strings.
- Test files (`update_cache.rs`, `release_plan.rs`, `update_cli.rs`, `portability.rs`) — test data renames; `portability.rs` adds a forbidden-slug scanner.
- Workflow (`release.yml`) — only renames `gdc/homebrew-tap` → `gregce/homebrew-tap` for the checkout step.
- Config / publishing scripts (`dist-workspace.toml`, `release/homebrew/patch-formula.mjs`, `release/trust/release-trust.mjs`) — same org rename in `tap` strings.
- `update-check.json` — a cache file accidentally committed; no executable behavior.

**Source → sink traces:**
- `LatestUpdate.archive_url()` (new URL rewriter) is only used in `update_shell_completed_surface` / `update_shell_requires_yes_surface` evidence panels — display only. The real download is performed by `axoupdater` with the hardcoded owner/name, so a malformed archive_url cannot redirect a download.
- `effective_prerelease = allow_prerelease || latest.version.contains('-')` reads `latest.version`, which comes from GitHub `tag_name` (or cache or current). The repository owner controls tag names; not attacker-controllable in the threat model. This is a behavior/UX expansion (silently allowing prereleases when only prereleases exist), not a security boundary violation — same trust root.
- `fetch_newest_any_release` fallback now triggers on ANY error from `/releases/latest` (not just 404). It still talks to the configured GitHub repo and the consumer (`axoupdater`) is still hardcoded to `gregce/deadreckon`. No new attacker-controllable input is introduced.
- Test env vars (`DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_RELEASE_URL`, `DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_SHELL_REPLACEMENT`, etc.) are pre-existing — present in unchanged context lines of the diff — so per the instructions I do not flag them here.
- Workflow rename: checkout target `gregce/homebrew-tap` uses `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` (a separately-scoped PAT for that tap repo). The token's authority is whatever was provisioned; nothing in the diff broadens its scope.
- Org rename consistency: tap string `gregce/homebrew-tap` and updater owner `gregce` are aligned across `dist-workspace.toml`, the workflow, the formula patcher, the trust manifest, the brew-upgrade hint, and `axoupdater.set_release_source` — no split-trust between announcement and install surfaces.

No exploitable source→sink path with an effective gap. No parser/validator differential, no allowlist semantic escape, no fail-open path, no sibling-handler gate omission, no new under-validated sink arg.
